description: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0-100) with its history in context: today's value and label, change against yesterday, a week and a month ago, 7/30/90-day averages, days spent in the current zone, the 90-day low and high, today's percentile over the past year and since 2018, and the last time the index was this low (or high). Optional daily series up to 365 days. Data: alternative.me, attributed. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

days.description: Daily readings to return as a series, 0-365 (default 0)
